title: Permit admission at the Tool Host

cases.title: A permit with an invalid signature is refused
given: A Tool Host pinned to Control effect key kid k1
A permit signed by an unrelated RSA key that claims kid k1
cases.when: The Gateway dispatches a permit whose signature does not verify against the pinned Control effect keys
then: The host answers REFUSED with reason PERMIT_INVALID
No sandbox starts and no permits/consume call is made
The refusal is audited with the permit jti

cases.title: A permit signed with a kid outside the pinned set is refused
cases.when: The Gateway dispatches a correctly signed permit whose kid is neither the current nor the previous effect key
then: REFUSED with PERMIT_INVALID; nothing runs

cases.title: A v1 enterprise permit is not accepted as a v2 invocation permit
cases.when: The Gateway dispatches a permit signed by the effect key with typ toolgate-effect-permit+jws
then: REFUSED with PERMIT_INVALID: only toolgate-invocation-permit+jws is accepted for v2 dispatch

cases.title: A permit addressed to another host is refused
cases.when: Host B receives a valid permit whose aud is host A
then: Host B answers REFUSED with PERMIT_INVALID
Control would also refuse consumption because the caller SAN host id differs from aud

cases.title: A permit past exp is refused even if the nonce is unused
cases.when: A valid permit arrives one millisecond after exp
then: The host answers REFUSED with PERMIT_EXPIRED
permits/consume called directly with the same permit returns 409 and leaves the invocation RESERVED

cases.title: Control never mints a permit with exp - iat above 10 s
cases.when: Permits are minted for deadlines of 1 s, 60 s and 15 min
then: Every permit has exp - iat <= 10000 ms
deadlineUnixMs carries the execution deadline separately

cases.title: The same permit dispatched twice to one host runs once
cases.when: The Gateway sends the same DISPATCH twice to the same host
then: The second DISPATCH is REFUSED by the per-host jti cache
Only one permits/consume call reaches Control

cases.title: A permit replayed to a second host never runs there
cases.when: A captured permit for host A is replayed to host B, and separately to host A after A consumed it
then: Host B refuses on aud
Host A refuses on jti; Control refuses the already consumed nonce with 409

cases.title: Arguments that do not match the permit digest are refused
cases.when: The Gateway sends a valid permit with arguments whose JCS digest differs from argumentsDigest
then: REFUSED with PERMIT_INVALID before consumption; nothing runs

cases.title: Any package, artifact, runtime, globals, profile or binding digest mismatch is refused
cases.when: For each digest claim in PermitTarget, the host is given content whose digest differs from the claim
then: Every variant is REFUSED (DIGEST_NOT_PRESENT when the content is absent, PERMIT_INVALID when it differs)
No variant reaches permits/consume

cases.title: A permit minted before an authorization epoch bump is refused at consumption
cases.when: A grant is revoked (epoch bump) between reserve and permits/consume
then: permits/consume returns 403 after re-evaluation
The invocation does not reach EXECUTING

cases.title: The Gateway process holds no permit, requestState or MAC key
cases.when: The Gateway configuration, environment, mounted secrets and memory-resident keystores are inspected in a deployed cluster
then: No private or symmetric key material is present
Gateway start does not fail for lack of one
